item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I am young enough that Clippit was only present in my childhood computer times, but I still remember.

I have broken images in my memory of that god-awful face staring at me… I can hear myself now… "grandma, Clippit won't go away!" Then, images. Sounds. Flashbacks. Her feet pounding up the stairs. Myself, fleeing from the desk. My grandmother's instructions in our last moments. "Duck and cover!" Then, nothing. An enveloping blackness. And after a brief eternity, a voice from the beyond the void.

"It looks like you've been killed! Would you like help?"

+1 for these awful memories being brought to light. Truly, all we mortals must face the bitter truth.
